_provenance:
Parametric atom forms of six (AA|AB) hybrids of Paper 58's l <= 2 panel (H1, H3, H5, H6, H8, H10), one positive symbol u per exponent region, built 2026-11-19 by running geovac.two_center_eri.hybrid_closed_form_shell's algebra with symbolic exponents (per-orbital normalisation dropped), piecewise in parallel and summed exactly, then collected into atoms; fields info and form copied verbatim from that run's output (debug/data/hybrid_ratio2_runs/__.json, fields result.info and form). Same key format as tests/data/paper58_hybrid_ratio_2026_11_19.json: (c, kind, kappa, [(constant, exponent)]), kind '1' | 'log' | 'Ei' (E1(kR) = -Ei(-kR)); constants GAM = Euler gamma, LOG: = ln x, P:

= p. Region maps are read from info (a_d/a_c in (0,1), (1, 1+rho), (1+rho, oo); eq1 a_d = a_c; eq2 a_d = a_c + a_p).
